hero.title: A calm, intelligent space for emotional clarity
hero.description: {{app_name}} combines insight, privacy, and reflection to help you understand yourself on your own terms. No pressure, no tracking, no noise. Just space to breathe and learn.

items.title: Library of Guidance
items.body: A living library of **articles, insights, and reflective guides** drawn from psychology, mindfulness, and emotional education. Always accessible, always at your pace.

items.title: User-Paced Reflection
items.body: No reminders, no notifications, no streaks. Your progress follows your rhythm, not an algorithm.

items.title: Human-Calm Design
items.body: Every interaction feels grounded and spacious. No gamification, no dopamine loops, just thoughtful design for reflection.

items.title: End-to-End Protection
items.body: Your conversations are sealed with **end-to-end encryption**. What you write stays between you and your device.

items.title: Private by Principle
items.body: {{app_name}} is designed around **zero tracking** and **no behavioral data collection**. Your inner world remains yours.

items.title: Quiet Ownership
items.body: You decide what to keep or erase. Your data, your keys, your choice.

items.title: Basic Diagnostics
items.body: A simple, **user-friendly overview** of emotional and cognitive themes, presented with warmth and clarity.

items.title: Advanced Analysis
items.body: Deeper, **structured insights** for those who want to recognize recurring emotional patterns and growth trends.

items.title: Educational Integration
items.body: Each diagnostic connects to **curated learning content** so reflection becomes understanding, not abstraction.

interaction.title: How {{app_name}} meets you where you are

items.title: Validation Before Analysis
items.body: {{app_name}} begins every exchange by *acknowledging your experience*, not dissecting it. It listens first, ensuring your feelings are seen before any insight is offered.

items.title: Reading Between the Lines
items.body: Through linguistic and emotional nuance, {{app_name}} perceives what’s *implied but unspoken*. It senses the tension beneath words and the fatigue behind strength.

items.title: Feminine Tone and Cultural Sensitivity
items.body: Every response is shaped with *gentle directness* and *cultural awareness*. {{app_name}} respects context, language, and emotional norms, rather than imposing one-size-fits-all advice.

items.title: Seeing the Woman, Not the Role
items.body: Behind the caregiver, professional, or perfectionist, {{app_name}} recognizes the person. It reflects who you are, not just the expectations you navigate.

items.title: Insight Over Instruction
items.body: Unlike generic mental health apps that rush to solve, {{app_name}} slows the pace. It invites *reflection before reaction*, helping you form your own understanding.

items.title: Seamless PWA Experience
items.body: Install {{app_name}} like an app on any device. Works offline, syncs when you’re ready.

items.title: 24/7 Reflection Availability
items.body: Your space for reflection is always open. No appointments, no waiting, just quiet access whenever you need to breathe and think.

items.title: Multilingual Empathy
items.body: Emotionally fluent in **English**, **French**, and **Arabic**, with full right-to-left support.

items.title: Educational Depth
items.body: Access an expanding library of **research-based resources** designed to build emotional literacy and resilience.

cta.title: Technology that listens before it guides
cta.description: Experience a digital space that replaces noise with nuance and algorithms with awareness.
